notes: based_on is a subproperty of derivative_of (transitive); 'the distribution Ubuntu is based on' presupposes one, so Func(based_on) is firm (README: one-value presupposition). Numbered stable releases is a class (Debian yes, Arch Linux no: rolling). q2 is fol (temporal): first release year in the 1990s. related[0] (the file extension of the base's packages) is not checked: no catalogued relation for a package file extension.
